title: JEPA-Shield: Safe Diffusion Planning with Latent World Models via Conformal Shielding
abstract: arXiv:2611.29609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models enable planning from images, but their predictions do not directly establish whether a robot will satisfy physical constraints. We present JEPA-Shield, which connects a frozen action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model to task-space safety enforcement. Two downstream models predict relative motion from imagined latent rollouts and decode unsafe geometry from the current image. Split conformal prediction turns end-to-end motion-prediction errors into multi-horizon uncertainty tubes. A backup-based shield checks these tubes against physical constraints and screens both candidate trajectories and final proposals in diffusion-inspired sampling-based model predictive control. Under the stated exchangeability and initial-backup assumptions, we establish probabilistic constraint satisfaction at action-block boundaries for a returned plan executed without replanning. We also introduce VPar

translated_title: JEPA-Shield：基于共形屏蔽的潜在世界模型安全扩散规划
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型使得从图像进行规划成为可能，但其预测并不能直接确定机器人是否满足物理约束。我们提出JEPA-Shield，它将一个冻结的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型与任务空间安全执行机制相连接。两个下游模型从想象的潜在轨迹中预测相对运动，并从当前图像中解码不安全几何结构。分裂共形预测将端到端的运动预测误差转化为多时域不确定性管道。基于备份的屏蔽器对照物理约束检查这些管道，并在受扩散启发的基于采样的模型预测控制中对候选轨迹和最终方案进行筛选。在所设定的可交换性与初始备份假设下，我们为无需重新规划而执行的返回规划在动作块边界处建立了概率性的约束满足保证。我们还引入了VPar（摘要在此处截断，内容不完整）
tldr: 提出JEPA-Shield框架，将冻结的JEPA潜在世界模型与共形预测产生的不确定性管道和基于备份的安全屏蔽相结合，在扩散式采样模型预测控制中实现从图像规划的概率性物理约束满足保证。
en_tdlr: JEPA-Shield couples a frozen JEPA latent world model with conformal-prediction uncertainty tubes and a backup-based shield, providing probabilistic constraint satisfaction guarantees for image-based planning with diffusion-inspired sampling-based MPC.
